From what I've gleaned so far, someone with "Low Latent Inhibition" gathers and operates with a larger breadth of "meta data" about every day objects and relationships. Abstracting the relationships between properties of things and ideas that aren't considered by others.

Your brain does a lot of short-cutting and abstracting for you, for example allowing you to use everyday objects without thinking about them consciously. Someone with Low Latent Inhibition might dwell on properties of an every day object and not take it for granted, and will learn through association with other ideas more about the item. [Like a normal person might just turn a doorknob but someone like me will often be visualizing the internal lock mechanism and thinking about a bump-key video I saw even though I am really just trying to go through the door]

http://www.wisegeek.com/what-is-latent-inhibition.htm#didyouknowout
Low Latent Inhibition - What it is

To expand on this, the inhibition bit is that your brain has a harder time filtering what is important and what isn't. Having a conversation with other things going on is more difficult, and busy situations can easily cause some overload.
